cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
# Original LMX C99 pooling helper. No ggml, Python, tokenizer or model download.
if(NOT COMMAND lmx_c99_target)
    function(lmx_c99_target target)
        set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
        if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
            target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
        endif()
    endfunction()
endif()
option(LMX_EMBEDDINGS_BUILD_TESTS "Build static embedding checks" ${BUILD_TESTING})
option(LMX_EMBEDDINGS_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build static embedding example" ${LMX_BUILD_EXAMPLES})
add_library(lmx_static_embeddings STATIC src/lmx_static_embeddings.c)
add_library(LMX::static_embeddings ALIAS lmx_static_embeddings)
lmx_c99_target(lmx_static_embeddings)
target_include_directories(lmx_static_embeddings PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_static_embeddings PUBLIC m)
endif()
add_library(lmx_embeddings INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::embeddings ALIAS lmx_embeddings)
target_link_libraries(lmx_embeddings INTERFACE lmx_static_embeddings)
if(LMX_EMBEDDINGS_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    add_executable(lmx_static_embeddings_test tests/static_embeddings_test.c)
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_static_embeddings_test)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_static_embeddings_test PRIVATE LMX::static_embeddings)
    add_test(NAME embeddings_static_ids COMMAND lmx_static_embeddings_test)
endif()
if(LMX_EMBEDDINGS_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
    add_executable(lmx_static_embeddings_example examples/static_embeddings.c)
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_static_embeddings_example)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_static_embeddings_example PRIVATE LMX::static_embeddings)
endif()
